sections.title: Selling Out Harmattan Jazz Weekend, Together

paragraphs: Thank you for Tuesday's conversation. You want three sold-out nights at Jabi Lake in December and a crowd that comes back next year, and we would like to help you get there.
What follows is how MyCity would sell your tickets, check your guests in at the gate and keep Harmattan Jazz Weekend in front of Abuja for the six weeks before it opens.
Everything here can change to suit you. If a page does not read right, tell me and we will make it so.

sections.heading: December Belongs to Abuja's Music Lovers
paragraphs: The festive season brings the city out, and live jazz by the lake is the kind of night people plan around. Last year's edition sold 2,100 tickets with almost no online presence.
This year the goal is 4,500 guests over three nights. That needs ticketing people trust, a promotion calendar that starts early and a check-in that keeps queues short at the gate.
sections.pull_quote: Three sold-out nights, and a crowd that comes back next December.
